title: CSSD Instrument Sterilization Tracking
content:
SOP: CSSD Instrument Sterilization Tracking (SOP-CSS-001)
DEPARTMENT: Operation Theatre
VERSION: 2.1
ROLES: cssd_tech, ot_nurse
PURPOSE: Biological spore indicator validation and barcode pack tracking.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of CSSD Instrument Sterilization Tracking in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of CSSD Instrument Sterilization Tracking in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of CSSD Instrument Sterilization Tracking in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of CSSD Instrument Sterilization Tracking in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of CSSD Instrument Sterilization Tracking in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of CSSD Instrument Sterilization Tracking in full compliance with Operation Theatre hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Operation Theatre.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
